question: Should plugin-sdk/meeting-runtime permanently expose the optional validateAudioBase64, decodeAudioBase64, and decodeInputAudioBase64 callbacks used by this fix?
rationale: The runtime fix is correct, but these fields become a supported plugin SDK contract; deciding whether this three-hook shape is the intended long-term API requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve additive callbacks
options.body: Accept the three optional hooks as the supported owner-injection seam because defaults preserve existing plugins and Google Meet owns the stricter policy.

options.title: Consolidate the contract
options.body: Refactor before merge to one shared audio-payload decoder contract if maintainers want fewer parallel SDK hooks to preserve long term.

options.title: Keep it plugin-private
options.body: Avoid expanding meeting-runtime and implement interception entirely inside Google Meet, accepting additional owner-local wrapper code.

recommendation.title: Approve additive callbacks
recommendation.body: Accept the three optional hooks as the supported owner-injection seam because defaults preserve existing plugins and Google Meet owns the stricter policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history shows ownership and merge responsibility for the adjacent Google Meet realtime audio architecture and shared transport boundaries.
